audit_result.proof_trace: publishTgeDetails unconditionally assigns s_saleStatus.askToken = askToken (L268) with no guard requiring s_saleStatus.askToken == address(0) before setting and no require(askToken != address(0)) check. All modifiers on the function (onlyLegion, whenNotPaused, whenSaleNotCanceled, whenSaleEnded, whenRefundPeriodIsOver) are timing/access guards only; none enforce either invariant. Both guards are entirely absent.
audit_result.attack_scenario: A compromised or malicious Legion admin calls publishTgeDetails a second time with a different or zero askToken address after distribution has started, redirecting or bricking all investor vesting claims (e.g., ILegionVesting.release(address(0)) at L596).

PROP-legion-backe-inv-021.text: askToken address can only be set once via publishTgeDetails and must be non-zero.
PROP-legion-backe-inv-021.assertion: publishTgeDetails(addr) => askToken == address(0) pre-call && addr != address(0)
